subject: prd/argus-ledger-lint
statement: When a ledger-touching change adds only a new, higher-numbered `A-n`/`E-n` entry (a legal append) or leaves all merged entries intact, the history arm shall report no defect.
rationale: the guard must be green on legal appends or it fights normal driving (D-5)
fit_criterion: on the legal-append fixture, the history arm reports zero defects and the gate verdict is unchanged
